verdict.rationale: Semgrep explicitly documents support for 30+ languages and ecosystem-specific scanning via Semgrep Code (SAST), Secrets, and Supply Chain (SCA with dependency/package ecosystem coverage and SBOM generation), covering major languages and package managers. Community reports corroborate broad language parsing (JS/TS/Python/Ruby/etc.) via tree-sitter, though some report edge-case parse failures on newer TypeScript syntax and performance slowdowns on large codebases. Missing for 10: independent benchmark validating claimed language/ecosystem breadth, and resolution of noted parsing/performance edge cases.
